bibl.title: Riedizione di P.Aberd. 12 E 127: stelle fra astronomia "ipparchea" e astrologia "Sotica"
bibl.seg: Martina Savio, Riedizione di P.Aberd. 12 e 127: stelle fra astronomia "ipparchea" e astrologia "sotica".
bibl.note: P. Aberd. 12 (= MP3 2002; LDAB 4956) is the only papyrological attestation of a peculiar type of catalogue-text (otherwise attested only in two extracts, one included in the Aratus Latinus, another in the scriptio inferior of the palimpsest known as the Codex Climaci Rescriptus) with 'markedly Hipparchan' technical features and data. It can therefore be regarded as one of the rare testimonies of the "astronomy of Hipparchus" and of his legacy. - P. Aberd. 127 is part of the same papyrus as P. Gen. III, 123 (= MP3 2065.1; LDAB 4684) and joins the witnesses of the peculiar astrological category of "Sothis texts". - The content of the two Aberdeen fragments and the reunification of P. Aberd. 127 (= MP3 2057; LDAB 4957) with the Geneva fragment provide further clues about their likely provenance from a context such as Soknopaiou Nesos or more generally a settlement in the Fayum.
